claims.claim: Body, engine and suspension parts for all model of Honda, Acura and Toyota cars and SUVs.
claims.evidence: Witness only saw a single photo of the front/hood area of a blue car; no parts inventory, labels, or part numbers were shown.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy.
claims.evidence: No Toyota branding/part number/label/serial tag or packaging markings were shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: The witness noted the headlight area looks intact, but the report does not show the specific clips/brackets or any close-ups of mounting points; glare/protective film may hide damage.

risks.risk: The item may not be the exact part the buyer needs (unknown make/model/year; only a generic front/hood area is visible).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the exact part name/label/part number (or VIN/registration details) and a shot showing the full part being sold (not just the car front).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown/possibly mismatched used body/trim/front assembly with limited verification.

risks.risk: Hidden accident/structural damage or misalignment (frame/chassis) that cannot be confirmed from a single front close-up.
risks.proof: A video/clip showing straight-on and side measurements/alignment checks, plus photos of underbody/engine bay mounts and any repair welds.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst-case for possible prior damage (as-is, no guarantee of alignment).

risks.risk: Engine and suspension condition not shown; the car may not start or may have faults.
risks.proof: A start-up video (cold start if possible) and a short drive/idle clip, plus dashboard warning lights check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-verified mechanical condition (body/trim value only).

risks.risk: Protective plastic/film may be covering dents, cracks, or missing clips/brackets.
risks.proof: Photos with the film/plastic removed, especially around mounting points, corners, and bracket/clip areas.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing rework/parts replacement due to unseen damage.

risks.risk: Tyre, brake, and suspension wear/defects are not visible; could affect overall value if the sale includes more than body parts.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tyres (tread depth), brake discs/pads, and suspension components (control arms/struts) if included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming unknown wear and possible additional costs.

risks.risk: Ownership/registration and legality of parts (or whether it’s a salvage/illegal source) not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of documents (receipt/transfer/part sourcing proof) and/or VIN/registration details matching the vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: Priced conservatively due to documentation not verified.

proof_requests: Show the exact part(s) being sold with clear close-ups of the mounting points/clips/brackets (with any protective film removed).
Provide part number/label or Toyota/Honda/Acura markings (and where it’s located) to verify it’s not a copy.
If it’s from a specific vehicle: share VIN/registration details and the make/model/year the parts fit.
If mechanical parts are included: provide start-up video and a short running/drive clip, plus any fault/error lights check.
Provide tyre tread/brake/suspension photos if those are part of the sale.
response.reason: The witness can only confirm a generic front/hood area of a blue car and cannot verify the specific part identity, part number/originality, or mechanical/suspension condition. Without a missing shot (part number/clear part identification), a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
